checkpoints.description: Pen-DHRL baseline, condition C0: no LLM shaping, no LLM distillation. Single seed.

best_checkpoint_selection.note: Applies to model_best.pt only, which is NOT used for the reported results (the final-step model.pt is, per the user). model_best.pt was chosen using the dynamic scenario on the old 64-env length-biased trainer eval. The final checkpoint was not selected on any evaluation scenario; the dynamic scenario is still not held out for it because it is in the training list.

corp_100hosts_dynamic.reason: in the training list AND used for best-checkpoint selection

corp_100hosts_dynamic_bridge.reason: not in the training list or selection under this run's command line; the plan text is stricter and only names _test, so treat as held-out with this caveat

corp_100hosts_dynamic_test.reason: not in the training list or selection

checkpoints.eval_seed_bank: 1_000_000 + k, disjoint from the training seed (1) and its per-env offsets

not_available: flat baselines (GNN, Invariant, Attention) on the dynamic scenarios
